title: Pioneer — the city that fixes itself first

scenes.vo: In the age of super intelligence,
our cities still break the old way.
Quietly. [pause] Underground. [pause] Until the street floods.
It's a living copy of downtown Abu Dhabi.
When a water main starts to fail, Pioneer hears it first. [emphasis] Days before it bursts.
Then, six AI agents take over.
Watch. Diagnose. Plan. Patch. Dispatch. Verify.
They weigh every fix, close the valves, and send the water another way.
But you hold the limits. Any big call waits for you.
Ask them why, and they'll tell you. Even in Arabic.
The right crew drives real streets,
and it's fixed, before it ever broke.
Twelve thousand four hundred people kept their water.
And almost six million dirhams, saved.
Pioneer. [pause] The city that fixes itself first.
